title: Avesta's island continent that froze over

tellings.quote: So in the Avesta it says that the the you know Arian the Aryan people uh come from an island continent at the center of the world which froze over

plain: The Avesta, the ancient sacred texts of Iran's old Zoroastrian religion, says the Aryan people came from an island continent at the center of the world that froze over. The researcher Jason Jorjani gives this reading on the show without pointing to a passage, and the place he links it to is Antarctica. If his reading holds, an old scripture would be remembering a homeland lost under ice.
